summary: RELX PLC filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026, announcing a board committee role change: Andy Halford appointed Chair of the Audit Committee effective after H1 2026 results publication at 7am on July 23, 2026. Suzanne Wood stepped down from the committee but remains on the board as Senior Independent Director and member of other committees. No forced departure or abrupt change; only a routine committee rotation. No deal terms or financial impact. This is a routine governance update, not a special situation. Category: Management Changes (low severity, not forced).
